val_original.note: Reconstructible from the pinned upstream revision; not required in Git.

ai4privacy_comparison_subset.note: The frozen TinyBERT aggregate was measured on all 16374 historical rows. The Model V2 comparison subset is the 16373 of those that are not also in a protected evaluation set, so the two row sets are not identical and the comparison is close but not exact.

pre_split.normalisation: NFKC, whitespace collapsed, casefolded, then blake2b-128 - the same fingerprint the firewall and the deduplicator use.
pre_split.policy: The protected validation/OOD row is kept and the colliding training-side copy is removed. Protected sets are never modified.

pre_write.normalisation: NFKC, whitespace collapsed, casefolded, then blake2b-128 - the same fingerprint the firewall and the deduplicator use.
pre_write.policy: The protected validation/OOD row is kept and the colliding training-side copy is removed. Protected sets are never modified.

absent.HEIGHT: Never present in the TinyBERT head; 1 span exists only in official validation.

added.PASSWORD: Protects disclosed credentials in conversational text. Admitted only through the credential-disclosure rules in password_rules.py.

derivation.note: HEIGHT was never in the 67-label head, so removing ALLERGIES, USERNAME and WEIGHT nets 33 - 3 = 30 entities; adding PASSWORD gives 31 entities and 63 BIO labels.

removed.ALLERGIES: 3 spans in the pinned project-train split; no supported source.
removed.USERNAME: 16 spans in the pinned project-train split; not an OnKith product need.
removed.WEIGHT: 1 span in the pinned project-train split; no source maps to it.

regeneration.note: Corpora are gitignored by design. Re-running the dataset sections with this manifest's seeds and pinned revisions must reproduce artifacts.val_supplementary.sha256 exactly.
regeneration.sections: Run sections 1-11 (Environment through manifest) to rebuild every corpus.

selection.note: carried_spans_by_label counts correctly mapped spans kept because their row was selected for a different label. Unmet targets are reported as measured evidence; data is never fabricated to close a shortfall.

sources.ontology_note: All annotations are mapped into the 31 Model V2 entity types; unmapped source labels become O and are counted in the mapping audit.

nemotron.name: nvidia/Nemotron-PII
nemotron.note: May be gated. If unavailable the build continues without it and records the failure.

component_diagnostics.note: per_factor is that factor alone; leave_one_out is every other factor together. A factor whose removal barely shrinks the largest component is not the cause of it.

supplementary.diagnostic_note: Diagnostic factors are measured, not enforced. Overlap here means train and holdout share a surface format, which is expected when a label has only one realistic format.

overlap_examples: COUNTRY:antarctica (the territory south of 60 deg s)

training_side.ai4privacy_test_note: The AI4Privacy test rows are the pinned historical project-validation vectors, so TinyBERT and DeBERTa are measured on identical rows.

component_diagnostics.note: per_factor is that factor alone; leave_one_out is every other factor together. A factor whose removal barely shrinks the largest component is not the cause of it.

training_side.diagnostic_note: Diagnostic factors are measured, not enforced. Overlap here means train and holdout share a surface format, which is expected when a label has only one realistic format.
